policy: Pages listed here are accessible but set to noindex,follow and excluded from the sitemap until reviewed against current primary sources. Evergreen lifestyle articles with usable structure and sources were released for indexing on 2026-06-26. The four government/business guides reviewed on 2026-07-07 and the four health/religious/travel guides reviewed on 2026-07-08 were removed after verification against official UAE, Saudi, WHO, and primary media sources. The six Business & Marketing guides (T46) were reviewed on 2026-07-10: all claims were already appropriately hedged with no fact-checkable hard numbers; 4 stale/broken official source URLs were corrected across both languages before release. The six Islamic Knowledge & Culture guides (12 EN/AR pages) were reviewed and released on 2026-07-11 after source-URL verification and claims review against established references. The UAE Practical Guides batch 2 (T50) and Saudi Practical Guides batch 2 (T49) were reviewed and released on 2026-07-11 after source URL checks, FAQPage schema checks, and local build/test verification. The UAE Practical Guides batch 3 (T55) was reviewed and released on 2026-07-13 after source-URL verification (two mislabeled uaelegislation.gov.ae citations were corrected before release) and local build/test verification. The 12 government-legal-finance guides (24 EN/AR pages) and 18 fast-changing-technology guides (34 EN/AR pages) were reviewed and released on 2026-08-01 after live web-research verification against current official sources (GOSI, ZATCA, HRSD/Qiwa, Ministry of Justice/Najiz, REGA, Saudi Customs, and current AI-vendor documentation): stale claims were corrected (GOSI's two-track contribution rate, a dead driving-school source domain, new non-Saudi property-ownership transaction fees, ChatGPT's outdated 2025 dating and browsing-capability claim plus five pages linking to that stale title, Gemini's GPT-4o/search-tier/Gemini-Advanced-rename claims, and Sora's discontinued-standalone-app status); the rest were confirmed already accurate and appropriately hedged. Retired sensitive root URLs are served only as noindex cleanup pages when substantive approval-required content is not being republished. The World Cup 2026 articles (the 30-article World Cup 2026 & Arab Football category plus the 48-team expansion explainer, 62 EN/AR pages) were set to noindex on 2026-09-28 after the tournament ended; they remain accessible and internally linked.
